newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices narrowly mixed.

text.p: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices were narrowly mixed in thin trade, as players moved to the sidelines ahead of Tuesday's U.S. crude and products inventory reports, brokers said.
In overnight trade, March heating oil trimmed 0.61 cents from its settlement level, trading at 65.55 cents a gallon several hours into ACCESS.
An extremely light 41 lots traded overall, with 16 exchanged in the front-month, traders said.
Meanwhile, March crude oil traded four cents above its settlement, touching $24.19 a barrel with trade volume at 134 lots for the nearby contract and 246 overall.
"There's a lack of fundamentals," a broker said. "People are hanging back to see what the (American Petroleum Institute) numbers will do tomorrow."
Front-month gasoline futures rose a mere 0.25 cents a gallon to 68.60 cents, but trade was razor-thin as 14 lots changed hands.
